manifest.name: Google Address Autocomplete
manifest.summary: Assist with automatic completion & suggestions when filling address
manifest.author: Odoo S.A.

models._description: Adds the Google Places API key as a system config parameter
relations: google_places_api_key (Char, config_parameter='google_address_autocomplete.google_places_api_key' -> stored in ir.config_parameter, not a column)

models._description: Injects the google_address_autocomplete widget onto the street field at view-render time (no new fields)
relations: no new fields; overrides _get_view to set widget='google_address_autocomplete' on street/street_name

security.note: No own ACL/record rules/groups. Both public routes self-gate at runtime via _get_api_key, which asserts request.env.user._is_internal(); the Google Places API key lives in ir.config_parameter (no field on any record), and res_config_settings_views.xml restricts the Settings field to base.group_system.

views.note: xml_loc=90: res.config.settings form inheritance (the Google Places API key + setup help) and res.partner / res.company form inheritance. No own model/views; the address widget is injected programmatically by res.partner._get_view, not declared in XML.

behavioral_notes.observation: The public, type='jsonrpc', website=True route is the type-ahead proposer. _perform_place_search first reads the ir.config_parameter 'google_address_autocomplete.minimal_partial_address_size' (default 5) and returns no results until the typed string is longer than that, so trivially short inputs never bill Google. It then builds params {key=api_key, fields='formatted_address,name', inputtype='textquery', types='address', input=partial_address, optional components='country:<cc>', language, sessiontoken=session_id} and calls _call_google_route('/autocomplete/json', params) = requests.get(GOOGLE_PLACES_ENDPOINT + route, params=params, timeout=2.5).json(). It logs results['error_message'] if present, then reshapes Google's predictions[] into [{formatted_address: prediction['description'], google_place_id: prediction['place_id']}] plus the session_id. TimeoutError/ValueError are swallowed into an empty result. None of this server-to-server HTTP to Google, the sessiontoken billing-grouping, nor the minimal-size guard is visible in Python model/field metadata.

Selecting a prediction calls the second public route with the google_place_id; _perform_complete_place_search GETs '/details/json' with fields='address_component,adr_address', then _translate_google_to_standard maps each Google address component type to Odoo address fields via the module-level FIELDS_MAPPING / FIELDS_PRIORITY tables: 'country' -> res.country.search([('code','=',short_name.upper())]) re-emitted as [id, name]; 'administrative_area_level_1/2' -> res.country.state.search scoped to that country by code or ilike name (only assigned when exactly one matches); locality/postal_town -> city, route -> street, postal_code -> zip, etc. It then resolves a res.city via res.partner._get_res_city_by_name(city_name, country_id) and back-fills state from city.state_id when missing. If Google omits the house number, _guess_number_from_input strips zip/street/city out of the user's raw input to recover it, and builds formatted_street_number (preferring the longer of the adr_address HTML vs the manual concat, to avoid Google's abbreviations like '52 HR St'). This cross-model resolution (Google codes -> live res.country/res.country.state/res.city records) is pure Python, invisible to metadata.

_get_api_key asserts request.env.user._is_internal() and returns ir.config_parameter 'google_address_autocomplete.google_places_api_key' (sudo). The two routes degrade differently on a non-internal caller: /autocomplete/address catches the AssertionError and returns empty results (so a public website visitor simply gets no suggestions and never spends the key), whereas /autocomplete/address_full re-raises it as AccessError("You don't have access to the full autocomplete feature."). The Google API key is passed to Google as the 'key' query parameter on every call with a hard 2.5s timeout; there is no provider-side rate limiting in this module. The auth boundary (public route + internal-user assertion + key in config-parameter, never exposed to the browser) and the asymmetric degrade-vs-raise behaviour are only knowable by reading the controller.

behavioral_notes.element: res.partner._get_view -- runtime widget injection gated on base_address_extended
behavioral_notes.observation: res.partner overrides _get_view: on a form view, only if 'enforce_cities' exists in res.country._fields (i.e. base_address_extended is installed) it xpath-finds //field[@name='street' or @name='street_name'] and sets widget='google_address_autocomplete' on each node before returning the arch. The autocomplete widget is therefore wired onto the partner address at view-render time with zero XML view records and is conditionally present depending on an unrelated module being installed -- a dependency that no manifest/metadata field expresses.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (static) -- google_address_autocomplete field widget + Places session token
behavioral_notes.observation: 2 JS files, 0 OWL components, 1 registry add (gap #3): static/src/google_places_session.js exports a googlePlacesSession singleton that mints a v4-style UUID sessiontoken (per Google's Place-Autocomplete session-billing rules -- one token spans many autocomplete queries + one details fetch, then is reset to null after getAddressDetails), exposing getAddressPropositions() -> rpc('/autocomplete/address') and getAddressDetails() -> rpc('/autocomplete/address_full'). static/src/address_autocomplete/google_address_autocomplete.js registers the 'google_address_autocomplete' field widget that renders the suggestion dropdown (with the 'Powered by Google' image, light/dark variants via web.assets_web_dark) and, on select, writes the resolved standard address back onto the record's street/city/zip/country/state fields. None of this browser behaviour is reachable from Python metadata (gap #3).

behavioral_notes.element: external integration surface (gap #7) -- Google Places (Maps Platform) API
behavioral_notes.observation: Static gap-#7 facts (extract_frontend.py): http_call_sites=1, sdk_imports=['requests'], uses_api_keys=true, single endpoint base https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place declared in controllers/google_address_autocomplete.py (GOOGLE_PLACES_ENDPOINT). Concrete endpoints reached: /autocomplete/json (Place Autocomplete) and /details/json (Place Details). Auth is a Google Maps Platform API key sent as the 'key' query parameter; billing is grouped by the per-session sessiontoken. This is the canonical metadata gap #7: a real outbound dependency on a Google cloud service that no model/field metadata can reveal -- established only by reading the controller.

it_architecture.application: google_address_autocomplete (server-side proxy + form widget that turns partial address typing into a Google Places lookup and writes the structured result onto res.partner; _inherit-only, no own models/views)
software_services: /autocomplete/address (jsonrpc, public, website: Place Autocomplete predictions for a partial address)
/autocomplete/address_full (jsonrpc, public, website: Place Details -> structured Odoo address; internal-user only, else AccessError)
data_objects: res.partner (inherit; _get_view widget injection, no new fields)
logical_data_erm: controller -> res.country (resolve country by ISO code from Google 'country' component)
controller -> res.country.state (resolve state by code/name within the resolved country)
controller -> res.city via res.partner._get_res_city_by_name (when base_address_extended present)
google_places_api_key stored in ir.config_parameter (key 'google_address_autocomplete.google_places_api_key'), not on a record
external: Google place_id is the cross-system key passed from /autocomplete/address to /autocomplete/address_full
information_flows: inbound-map: Google address_components -> _translate_google_to_standard -> {country:[id,name], state:[id,name], city, street, zip, number, formatted_street_number} resolved to live res.country/res.country.state/res.city
frontend: googlePlacesSession (UUID sessiontoken) -> rpc /autocomplete/address (type-ahead) then /autocomplete/address_full (on select) -> write street/city/zip/country/state onto the record
config: google_places_api_key (ir.config_parameter, group_system) read sudo by _get_api_key after a _is_internal() assertion
frontend_components: google_address_autocomplete (field widget: address-suggestion dropdown with 'Powered by Google', writes the structured address back)
googlePlacesSession (JS singleton: mints/expires the Google Places sessiontoken; getAddressPropositions / getAddressDetails rpc wrappers)

capabilities: Address type-ahead: suggest full postal addresses from a partial string via Google Places
Structured address capture: turn a chosen suggestion into Odoo street/number/city/zip/state/country fields
House-number recovery from raw user input when Google omits it
Configurable Google Places API key (Settings, system-only) and minimal-input-size threshold
value_streams: Type-to-Address: user types a partial address -> /autocomplete/address (Google Autocomplete) -> pick suggestion -> /autocomplete/address_full (Google Details) -> _translate_google_to_standard -> partner address fields populated
information_concepts: res.partner address (street, street2, city, zip, state_id, country_id, city_id) -- the data enriched
organization: (no module-owned res.groups; the API-key setting is restricted to base.group_system, and full lookups require an internal user via _is_internal())
policies: Both endpoints require an internal user to obtain the API key (_get_api_key asserts _is_internal); /autocomplete/address degrades to empty for non-internal callers, /autocomplete/address_full raises AccessError
No Google call until the partial address exceeds google_address_autocomplete.minimal_partial_address_size (default 5) -- cost guard
Hard 2.5s timeout on every Google request; TimeoutError/ValueError -> empty result (fail-soft)
Google Places API key held only server-side in ir.config_parameter (group_system), never shipped to the browser
State assigned only on an unambiguous (exactly-one) res.country.state match within the resolved country
stakeholders: End user entering an address on a partner/company/contact form
System administrator (enters the Google Places API key in Settings; owns the Google Cloud billing)
Google (Maps Platform / Places API -- external geocoding provider)
metrics: (no own reports; Google-side usage/billing is metered in the Google Cloud console, not in Odoo)

classification.rationale: google_address_autocomplete is a master-data data-entry utility, not a business object of any value chain/shop/network -- it owns no transactional model (2 _inherit-only models: res.config.settings adds one config-parameter Char, res.partner only overrides _get_view; 0 own security records; ~715 py LOC almost entirely in one controller). It is shared firm IT infrastructure (Porter support activity; Stabell & Fjeldstad 'support'): a thin proxy that fetches address suggestions from Google's Places network and writes them onto the partner master that sale/purchase/account/crm reuse. category Hidden/Tools and auth='public' degrading to internal-only confirm invisible plumbing, not a user-facing app. A value-NETWORK reading was weighed (the module mediates Odoo<->Google Places, gap #7), but, exactly as the sibling partner_autocomplete.metamodel.json reasons, the mediation is incidental egress to an external provider; the module's enterprise substance is improving the quality/completeness of partner address master data -> APQC 13.0 Develop and Manage Business Capabilities (master-/reference-data management, 13.x), the same category as partner_autocomplete. 8.0 Manage IT was rejected (it ships no IT-service plumbing of its own) and 3.0 Market & Sell was rejected (it sells nothing).

standard_capabilities: Google-Places-backed address type-ahead on res.partner address fields
Place prediction (Autocomplete) + structured detail fetch (Details) split across two routes with one billing session token
Mapping of Google address components to Odoo country/state/city/street/zip with house-number recovery
System-only Google Places API key configuration in Settings + minimal-input-size config parameter
Conditional widget injection onto the partner address when base_address_extended is installed
typical_fits: Speeding up and standardising address entry on contacts/companies/customers/vendors
Reducing typos / malformed addresses on partner master data used downstream for delivery & invoicing
Deployments that already hold a Google Maps Platform API key and accept Google as a data sub-processor
common_gaps: Requires a paid Google Maps Platform key + outbound HTTPS to maps.googleapis.com; air-gapped or no-Google deployments get no autocomplete
Coverage/quality is Google's; regions Google maps poorly degrade silently to empty
Only the partner street field path is wired (via _get_view); other address-bearing models need their own widget wiring
No local audit/log of lookups or Google spend (metered in Google Cloud, gap #7)
State is set only on an exact single res.country.state match; ambiguous regions are left blank for the user to pick
Privacy/compliance: partial address strings are sent to Google -- may need a DPA / regional review

Whether _translate_google_to_standard's self.env usage in the http.Controller resolves a res.city correctly at runtime (would need a live call to confirm the city_id branch).
